rows.text: returns 0 unless `edx` is 1; for 1 calls `002973E0(rcx, dword at r8, dword +0x24 of the object at qword +0x48 of rcx, dword at r8+4)` and returns -1 when that returns 0, else 0

with the object at qword `+0x48` of `rcx`: when `edx` is 2 stores its dword `+0x2C` shifted left by 4 at `+0x4` of `rcx` and returns 0; when `edx` is 1 calls `002973E0(rcx, dword at r8, its dword +0x30 multiplied by its byte +0x87 when that byte is non-zero, dword at r8+4)` and returns -1 when that returns 0, else 0; any other `edx` returns 0

switches on the dword at `rdx`: 1 stores the qword pointed to by qword `+0x8` of `rdx` at `+0xC0` of `rcx`, clears bit 7 of dword `+0x40`, calls `00247570(rcx, 002735E0(1))`, stores dword 0x800080 at `+0xD8` and returns 0; 3 scales, on the object at qword `+0x38`, word `+0x5A` by word `+0xD8` and word `+0x58` by word `+0xDA` of `rcx` (signed product shifted right by 7) and returns 0; other values tail-jump `005C5230` with `rcx` and `rdx` as passed in
